blocks.text: Iva Jovic successfully defended her Guadalajara Open title, beating fellow American Peyton Stearns, 6-4, 6-2, in the final Saturday in Mexico. The 18-year-old Jovic, the No. 2 seed, won her second career WTA Tour title without dropping a set throughout the tournament. Jovic won her first WTA title in Guadalajara last year at 17 and became the first repeat singles champion in the tournament’s history.
